H3.title: Matched-reference catalogue specificity across SMAG (soil) vs GEM (general Earth microbiomes) under gene-caller harmonization, within-pool deduplication, and exact 1-aa length quota matching
supported_claims: Across the full 212,084-query census (106,042 recurrent Dark queries + 106,042 matched Control queries; query_all.faa SHA-256 1b0cda14...), when SMAG (1,500 MAGs, seed 20261014) and GEM (2,055 MAGs, seed 20261014) are called de novo with Pyrodigal v3.7.1 (-p meta --no-stop-codon), deduplicated within pool, and downsampled to exact 1-aa common-support length quotas (4,210,592 unique proteins and 1,295,970,055 residues per arm; matching_closure_audit.tsv row 2), Dark queries match SMAG at 28.35% (30,064/106,042; both_hits_a=8,015, smag_only_b=22,049) vs GEM at 9.81% (10,399/106,042; gem_only_c=2,384, neither_d=73,594), a paired difference of +18.54 percentage points and discordant ratio b/c = 9.25, whereas Control queries match SMAG at 93.99% (99,673/106,042) vs GEM at 90.89% (96,385/106,042), a paired difference of +3.10 percentage points and discordant ratio b/c = 2.56 (matched_full_census_summary.tsv rows 2-3).

The Dark SMAG-over-GEM enrichment holds across pre-matching shared-sequence removal (harmonized_seed20261014_no_overlap: 4,185,525 proteins per arm, 0 shared sequences; Dark Delta = +18.62%, Control Delta = +3.29%; rows 4-5), a 30% sequence-identity floor (--id 30: Dark Delta = +18.14%, Control Delta = +3.15%; rows 6-7), two additional harmonized 2,055-genome GEM draws (seed 20261015: Dark Delta = +16.83% [28.12% vs 11.29%, b/c = 7.01]; seed 20261016: Dark Delta = +16.91% [28.34% vs 11.42%, b/c = 6.80]; rows 8-11), and end-to-end caller-plus-matching sensitivity using published GEM Prodigal v2.6.3 proteomes (seeds 20261014-20261016: Dark Delta = +18.46%, +16.87%, +16.91%; rows 12-17).

Across all 5 query length strata in matched_length_stratified_results.tsv (rows 2-11), Dark paired Delta increases monotonically with length (<100 aa: +15.29%; 100-149 aa: +18.29%; 150-249 aa: +21.10%; 250-399 aa: +24.55%; >=400 aa: +30.88%), whereas Control paired Delta narrows from +4.17% (<100 aa) to 0.00% (>=400 aa). Direct reweighting of Dark queries to the shorter Control length distribution still yields Dark paired Delta = +17.52% (verification_output.json -> h3_verification.census_and_stratified_verification.length_reweighting_sensitivity_seed20261014).
prohibited_claims: Do NOT claim that the three GEM draws (seeds 20261014-20261016) measure SMAG-side sampling uncertainty or constitute biological replication; SMAG is a single fixed random draw of 1,500 MAGs (3.75% of 40,039 SMAG MAGs).

Do NOT claim GEM genomes were selected via an adaptive unique-protein accumulation stopping rule; 03_fetch_and_call_gem.py (lines 415-418) selects a fixed count of ceil(4,500,000 * 1.05 / 2,300) = 2,055 genomes per seed.

Do NOT claim harmonized vs published GEM comparisons isolate pure caller disagreement on fixed sequence pairs; changing the GEM caller changes the 1-aa common-support quotas and resamples SMAG (end-to-end caller-plus-matching sensitivity).
Do NOT treat binomial McNemar p-values (0.000e+00) as independent superpopulation trials without noting MAG/lineage clustering.
concrete_closure_conditions: Add 2-3 bounded sentences to manuscript/main.tex lines 358-368 reporting the primary harmonized 1-aa quota-matched contrast (+18.54% Dark vs +3.10% Control) and the 3-seed GEM draw range (+16.83% to +18.54%), overlap-excluded (+18.62%), and --id 30 (+18.14%) sensitivities, with full tables in the Supplement.

H4.title: qTM-based paired whole-chain vs confident-region cropped Foldseek structural census (5,851 models, 7,773 regions), Foldseek 10-941cd33 alnTM > 1 source audit, and ORIX GPU prefilter sensitivity
H4.endorsed_manuscript_strategy: FULLY_CONFIRMED_POOLED_QTM_STRATEGY: Remove active historical alnTM-threshold classifications and counts (95/936/849/87/797/68) from biological/structural claims in manuscript/main.tex and replace with the qTM-only paired full-cohort census pooling all 1,031 initial whole-chain qTM-low dark models (K_pooled = K_local_pdb [849] + K_local_afdb_only [87] + K_dual_none [95]), alongside qTM-defined Q_not_K subsets (Q_not_K_pdb = 1,107; Q_not_K_afdb_only = 700; Q_not_K_all = 1,807; total Q = 2,838) and positive controls (3,013), all evaluated within the same Round 7 Foldseek run against the frozen PDB database.
supported_claims: Across all 2,838 confidence-qualified dark models (mean_plddt >= 0.70), the pooled cohort K_pooled (N = 1,031 models; 984 region-eligible, 47 no-region, 1,518 confident regions) is 100% identical to the set of models with historical whole-chain best_pdb_qtm < 0.5 and best_afdb_qtm < 0.5, and Q_not_K_pdb (N = 1,107; best_pdb_qtm >= 0.5), Q_not_K_afdb_only (N = 700; best_pdb_qtm < 0.5 and best_afdb_qtm >= 0.5), Q_not_K_all (N = 1,807), total Q (N = 2,838), and positive controls (N = 3,013) are defined strictly by whole-chain qTM and pLDDT >= 0.70, with zero dependence on alnTM (verification_output.json -> h4_verification.h4_tm_anomaly_and_flash_audit.qtm_only_pooled_census.definitions_strictly_qtm_and_plddt_independent_of_alntm = true).

In the paired Round 7 CPU Foldseek census (--alignment-type 1 -e 10 -s 9.5 --max-seqs 1000 against the frozen PDB database), within K_pooled (N = 1,031; Tiers 0-3 identical): 67/1,031 (6.50%) match at the whole-chain level (qTM >= 0.5) and 964/1,031 (93.50%) are whole-chain unmatched (919 region-eligible); after confident-region cropping (contiguous smoothed pLDDT >= 0.70, length >= 50 aa), 775/1,031 (75.17% unconditional; 775/984 = 78.76% region-eligible; 775/946 = 81.92% remaining-hit-conditional) match at qTM >= 0.5 (774/1,031 = 75.07% at Tier 4, fident < 0.20). Among the 964 whole-chain-unmatched models in K_pooled, 714/964 (74.07% unconditional; 714/919 = 77.69% region-eligible) recover a qTM >= 0.5 PDB match after cropping at Tiers 0-3 (713/964 = 73.96% at Tier 4), while 61/67 (91.04%) whole-chain-matched models retain a crop match (verification_output.json -> qtm_only_pooled_census.K_pooled_all_initial_qtm_lt_0.5).

Within Q_not_K_pdb (N = 1,107; 1,037 eligible, 70 no-region, 1,247 regions), 1,107/1,107 (100.0%) match whole-chain and 1,009/1,107 (91.15% unconditional; 1,009/1,037 = 97.30% eligible) retain a cropped-region match across Tiers 0-4. Within Q_not_K_afdb_only (N = 700; 669 eligible, 31 no-region, 883 regions), 301/700 (43.00%) match whole-chain against PDB under -s 9.5 and 569/700 (81.29% unconditional; 569/669 = 85.05% eligible) match after cropping at Tiers 0-3 (568/700 at Tier 4), with 292/399 (73.18% unconditional; 292/378 = 77.25% eligible) WC-unmatched models recovering a PDB match after cropping (verification_output.json -> qtm_only_pooled_census).

Across all 2,838 confidence-qualified dark models (Q_all; 2,690 eligible, 148 no-region, 3,648 regions), whole-chain PDB matches (qTM >= 0.5) are 1,475/2,838 (51.97%) and cropped-region PDB matches are 2,353/2,838 (82.91% unconditional; 2,353/2,690 = 87.47% eligible) at Tiers 0-3 (2,351/2,838 = 82.84% at Tier 4), with 1,006/1,363 (73.81% unconditional; 1,006/1,297 = 77.56% eligible) whole-chain-unmatched models recovering a qTM >= 0.5 match after cropping.

Positive controls (N = 3,013; 3,000 eligible, 13 no-region, 4,125 regions) achieve whole-chain and unconditional cropped-region qTM >= 0.5 match rates of 96.52% (2,908/3,013) and 96.32% (2,902/3,013; 96.73% eligible) at Tier 0, 95.52% (2,878/3,013) and 95.88% (2,889/3,013; 96.30% eligible) at Tier 1 (self-PDB4 excluded), and 94.32% (2,842/3,013), 93.69% (2,823/3,013), and 92.80% (2,796/3,013) at Tiers 2, 3, and 4 (fident < 0.30, 0.25, 0.20).

In Foldseek 10-941cd33, structureconvertalis.cpp:898 passes normalizationLen = min(res.qEndPos - res.qStartPos, res.dbEndPos - res.dbStartPos) = min(qspan - 1, tspan - 1) (missing + 1 on 0-indexed inclusive coordinates), which alters parameter_set4search, d0, score_d8, and superposition optimization inside TMaligner.cpp and produces 2,194 raw rows with alntm > 1.00001 across 228 control queries in Round 7 (and 47 PDB / 85 AFDB control rows > 1.0 in historical per_control_structures.tsv.gz). OUTFMT_QTMSCORE (structureconvertalis.cpp:903, passing res.qLen) is unaffected by this specific alignment-span coordinate defect.
prohibited_claims: Do NOT retain active historical alnTM-threshold classifications or counts (95 dual-none, 936 local-match, 849 K_local_pdb, 87 K_local_afdb_only, 797 high-coverage local matches, 68 controls < 0.5) as biological or structural claims in the manuscript; treat historical alnTM subdivisions strictly as archived pipeline/software diagnostics.

Do NOT claim that alnTM * (L - 1) / L is an exact recalculation of alnTM or that heuristic bands [0.5, 0.5051] / [0.5, 0.5102] or top-qTM span rescalings provide validated bounds on alnTM threshold crossings; retain all raw Foldseek scores unmodified on disk.

Do NOT repeat any of Flash's five errors in h4_tm_anomaly/DIAGNOSIS.md and findings.json (claiming 100% Control match rate or 94.75% Tier 0/1 crop rate; stating 5,851 cropped regions instead of 7,773; reporting 5-tier (query, tier) tuple counts as unique models/regions; claiming dark alnTM < 1.0 scores are immune to the structureconvertalis.cpp:898 defect; or relaxing verification bounds to alnTM <= 1.0200).

Do NOT claim that qTM is guaranteed free of all possible software approximations/defects; state precisely that OUTFMT_QTMSCORE is unaffected by the specific structureconvertalis.cpp:898 alignment-span off-by-one defect.

Do NOT claim that confident-region cropping isolates a single causal mechanism; cropping jointly alters query length normalization (L_q and d_0(L_q)), structural content (removing low-pLDDT segments/isolating domains), and search/multiple-testing opportunity across regions.

Do NOT declare ORIX GPU sensitivity (array job 315233) closed until Root's raw audit job 53796103 completes, and frame ORIX GPU (--gpu 1 --prefilter-mode 1) strictly as an ungapped-prefilter sensitivity rather than an exact CPU replay or a fix for the Foldseek 10-941cd33 alnTM bug.
concrete_closure_conditions: Restructure manuscript/main.tex Section 'Whole-protein and local structural matches give different reference-coverage estimates' (lines 307-351) to remove active historical alnTM-threshold classifications/counts (95, 936, 797, 68) and replace the main structure result with the qTM-only paired full-cohort census (Pooled K: N = 1,031; CPU Tier 1 WC matched 67/1,031 [6.50%], WC unmatched 964/1,031; Crop matched 775/1,031 [75.17% unconditional, 78.76% eligible]; WC-unmatched recovery 714/964 [74.07% unconditional, 77.69% eligible]; alongside Q_not_K_pdb [1,107], Q_not_K_afdb_only [700], total Q [2,838], and Controls [3,013]).
